effective_status.description:
EffectiveStatus derives lifecycle at read time from the observed expiry:
IAM's model makes revocation AN expiry (revoke sets expires_at=now), so
expires_at <= now reads as "revoked" — matching IAM's own
get_effective_status(). Equal to Status when no expiry has been observed
(never-validated rows, and sak_ keys whose validate response has no expiry).

known.description:
Known is false when the key produced usage but has no directory row —
traffic from before the directory was enabled, or a key the consumer has
not observed yet. This is an EXPECTED state, not an error; do not render
it as a warning.

owner_tpn.description:
Identity observed from IAM validate on the auth path (#5473). Empty until
the key authenticates at least once after identity capture shipped.

unattributed.description:
Unattributed marks the single reserved row for traffic with no api_key_id.
The key renders as "" — byte-identical to what group_by=api_key already
returns for the same traffic — so this boolean, not a magic string, is how
a caller identifies it.

unpriced_records.description:

priced and some were not — and must be surfaced as such rather than as a
final figure. If cost is ABSENT, nothing was priced and there is no
numeric lower bound at all; the total is simply unknown.

avg_ttft_ms.description:

cached_prompt_tokens.description: CachedPromptTokens is the prefix-cache hit portion of prompt tokens.

cancel_rate.description: CancelRate is ABSENT (not 0) when there were no requests to divide by.

canceled_requests.description: CanceledRequests counts client-gone exchanges (the caller walked away).

cost.description:
Cost is ABSENT (not 0) when no record in this group was priced. Absent
means unknown cost, not free, and carries no numeric lower bound —
see unpriced_records for the partially-priced case.

currency.description: Currency is present only alongside cost (USD-only at ingest in v1).

error_rate.description:
ErrorRate is ABSENT (not 0) when there were no requests to divide by. An
endpoint that served nothing has no error rate — that is not a 0% error
rate, and rendering it as 0 reports health that was never measured.

failed_requests.description: FailedRequests counts upstream-side failures that were still metered.

latency_p50_ms.description:

percentiles_exact.description:

success_requests.description: SuccessRequests is DERIVED (requests - failed - canceled), never stored.

Deletes up to 50 projects inside the caller's IAM organization boundary. For an authenticated, syntactically valid request, per-project outcomes are reported in the 200 body; the request itself fails only on authentication (401) or malformed/invalid input (400). Projects of another organization are reported as NOT_FOUND items (stealth not-found). 테넌트의 API 키별 사용 현황을 조회합니다 (#5235). 신원은 api_key_directory, 사용량 윈도우(1d/7d/30d/MTD)는 aggregated_usage 에서 조회 시점에 계산합니다. project_id 는 사용량만 좁히며 신원은 조직 범위입니다(키는 여러 프로젝트에 걸쳐 쓰일 수 있음). unpriced_records > 0 이면 해당 cost 는 하한값입니다.
